(BUILT + PROVEN + WIRED 2026-07-23, host-seam) c — the WRITE GATE: 'a source was written' fires a poke of the compile door — the LIVE recompile-on-change (shrinking-footprint — the write IS the event, no polling). Built as a FileChanged HOST-SEAM: recompile_gate.sh (git, proven — 3 teeth) + a hook in .claude/settings.local.json (instance-space). Host-NOTICING, an IOU standing in for the owner-gate emit (the emit-chokepoint physics state-machine-physics.json tracks) that is the resting state — kin to cairn-command's PATH seam (a host dependency named as debt, not faked into physics), retires when that emit lands. watchme: none, because this node's efficacy is already instrumented WITHOUT a probe, and a probe would be a second, weaker instrument for the same question. The compile is event-fired on READ (recompile_gate.sh), and every poke is counted at the trace wire — so 'is the model actually consulted, and is it fresh when consulted?' is answered continuously by the counter, not by a watch that would have to accumulate the same evidence a second time. RECORDED 2026-08-03, late and honestly: this node crossed to v2 on 2026-08-01 via emit_migrated with an author present, and the author dropped the watch without recording the reason — so watchme_spec's sweep has been red on this one ticket since that crossing. It is not fallout of the 2026-08-03 scrub sweep (measured: red on the pre-session tree too); it is the debt that sweep surfaced.

filed_edges: (d) THE GATHER SCOPE IS THE FALSIFIER, AND IT IS FALSIFIED — measured 2026-07-30 (during ticket watchme-emits-a-probe, whose skill-charter edits provoked the check). This ticket's falsifier says 'every source represented, nothing invented'. gather_sources (cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/compiler.py:170) scans exactly os.listdir(code_root)/<component>/intention+why.json with code_root=<repo>/cairn — ONE level, under ONE directory. Measured: 33 beside-code charters exist in the repo; the model carries 19 (+8 homeless = count 27). FOURTEEN ARE INVISIBLE: all ten skills/*/ (challenge, chart, commit, intent, loadslate, moreabout, note, sail, saveslate, sorted) plus bin/, launchers/, learning/, press_office/. Reproduce: `find . -name intention+why.json -not -path './.git/*' | wc -l` (33) against `python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('CairnCommons/intentions-congruency-lab/_model.json'))['count'])"` (27). · CLOSED 2026-08-01: the fix landed 2026-07-31 ahead of this edge's disposition — gather_sources walks the WHOLE repo (<repo>/**/intention+why.json), _model.json is DELETED, the lab holds byte-identical copies. Measured at close: 44 sources copied (35 beside-code + 9 homeless), proof tooth test_the_real_repo_reaches_both_trees_and_every_charter pins the reach.

(e) THE bin/ EDGE GREW TEETH AND NOBODY WAS TOLD. The state cursor above already filed 'a repo-root bin/ charter is not yet gathered (gather scans cairn/*/)' on 2026-07-23 — a one-charter edge on a directory with no state. On 2026-07-29 ticket skills-ride-the-chokepoint gave the ten skills charters AND state.json/history.json — they became beside-code components in every sense CLAUDE.md names — and the edge silently became a 14-charter hole. Nothing reported the change because the compiler REPORTS SUCCESS AND A COUNT AND NEVER SAYS WHERE IT DID NOT LOOK: same silent-accept class as troubles/append-door-has-no-schema-gate. Consequence, not theory: /intent's dup/conflict gate (skills/intent/SKILL.md) reads _model.json, so 14 intentions cannot be found by the cheapest gate in the system (Law 1's own door), and CLAUDE.md's 'carried to a bare machine and regrow the system' is short by 14 charters. /sorted's write-through rule is the one contradicted by measurement: a skill charter write pokes recompile_gate.sh and the door dutifully recompiles WITHOUT it. · CLOSED 2026-08-01 by the same fix, with the honest residue named: the walk skips _SKIP_DIRS (.git, __pycache__, proofs, validations, …) — a charter berthed under one of those would be invisible, and none legitimately berths there. The silent-count failure class shrank with the envelope: the lab IS the corpus now, so a missing charter is a missing FILE (diffable), not a number nobody can check.

(f) THE FIX IS NOT TAKEN HERE, DELIBERATELY. Widening the glob is a two-line change and exactly the kind of silent widening /sail forbids: which directories are model sources is a DESIGN question (is bin/ an intention? is launchers/? does the scan walk the repo or read a declared roster?), and a wrong answer quietly changes what the dup-check sees. Cheapest honest shape, unratified: gather takes a declared list of scan roots and REFUSES ON A CHARTER IT FOUND OUTSIDE THEM, so the next gap is loud at the door instead of measured six days late. Wants Akien's signature gate. · CLOSED 2026-08-01 — the design question this edge refused to answer silently was answered by AKIEN, 2026-07-31, unambiguous (recorded in the door's own docstring): the scan walks the repo; every intention+why is a source; the one-artifact _model.json dies. The signature this edge waited on arrived twice — that ratification, and today's 'fix the recompile … approved, go go go' (gate-record lb-20260801-f4f21cbb). The declared-roster alternative died with the envelope.
